decisions.reason: The charting bundle has its own page and four quick releases, which signals active development and early traction. It extends the map.apps platform at low marginal cost, so results meet aspiration and there is no trigger for search.

This small plugin is only mentioned, not promoted, so its visibility could fade. Still, it is cheap to maintain within the established platform, and the firm's slack in a growing industry lets it carry the plugin.

The VueTOC component was featured on the home page with a reported usability improvement, so it is meeting aspiration as a reusable mobile component. Its framework-specific technology carries some risk of being absorbed into newer offers.

The platform for building GIS solutions is core to the firm's reusable architecture strategy. Dropping it would undermine the established business, so the firm will keep it despite its low website visibility.
Mobile field data capture has its own page and serves steady public-sector and utility demand close to the core business. Performance appears satisfactory relative to aspiration.
The search extension has a dedicated page and fits the firm's established web map offering. There is no performance shortfall that would prompt problemistic search.
